about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, brakes, steering and suspension, tires and wheels. We work out of Greenville and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Nancy Brooks
reviews.text: HONEST AUTO REPAIR! IDEAL AUTO is the place to go for repairs on your automobile. My air conditioner was NOT WORKING for 3 yrs because of the price to fix it by the dealership. This day and age it's very difficult to locate a repair shop that is honest and knowledgeable. As members of Palmetto Business Association that's how I met Zen with Ideal Auto and his wife Sandy. Ideal auto is the place for me and all my family! Jose and Zen took great care of my car, fixing the air conditioning and providing results for a 27 point system too. It was fixed for 1/3 of what the dealership quoted. When you're in need for an auto repair, go to IDEAL AUTO! Zen will have your vehicle repaired in no time and the fees are affordable. He looks out for his clients, I felt like family.

reviews.author: Allen Auto Detailing
reviews.text: Zen has come through for me every time my work van has needed service. He always works me in same day and finishes the work within 1-2 days. He even works on German cars and transmissions! If you're looking for a trustworthy mechanic who will take care of you, Ideal Auto Repair is the place!

reviews.author: April Mendez
reviews.text: Best auto body repair shop in the US. Professional, quick, and friendly service. Our family of 5 with 1 on the way was stranded without money or food or a place to stay as our alternator went out and our car was broken down. My husband is a 100% legally disabled US Veteran from Operation Enduring Freedom. I am unable to leave him by himself and care for him 24/7. He is able to drive while I doordash. We are continuing to pray for favor so that we can get into a place so that I can legally apply to be his caretaker so we don't have to be homeless anymore but as no taxpayer funded programs for veterans have been willing to help us with this for the past 6 years we are on our own. Thank God for people like Officer Steven who offered to pay for our alternator and services. Zen did not let him foot the bill and payed for half the alternator and the services. And yesterday, Officer Joseph bought us a battery and Officer Gilmore attempted to get us a hotel stay. God bless you all.

reviews.author: Laura Richard
reviews.text: I would never call any other mechanic to fix my car! Ideal Auto has worked on my old wreck and kept it running better than it did when it was new! If I break down, he always comes quickly to get my car. And I have literally cried because he is so much more reasonably priced than anyone else. Years ago, noone could seem to figure out what was wrong with my jeep. I went to several different mechanic shops, and even the jeep dealer told me something totally outrageous. I took a friend to Ideal to pick her car up and happened to ask about my jeep problem...they knew exactly what was wrong, quoted a price over $1,000 cheaper than everyone else, and fixed it for under $200. I have never used anyone else since, and have always been completely happy. He fully guarantees all his work, and they are the nicest people you will ever deal with! You will not be sorry, I promise you!

reviews.author: Captain Caveman
reviews.text: This is the only mechanic (and towing) my wife and I use. They have gotten us through every emergency we've had over the years. Friendly, reasonably priced and quick service. We have no intentions of using anyone else. Thanks for all you do.

reviews.author: Mario Ercolini
reviews.text: I have used Ideal Auto Repair four times in the last couple of years. It is re-assuring to used a company you can trust completely. I also enjoy the fact that Zen is the owner and he is always willing to give you his opinion based upon what he would do. I strongly recommend this auto repair and towing service.

reviews.author: Jose Estevez
reviews.text: I arrived at Ideal Auto Repair LLC & Towing without an appointment and was helped immediately with great professionalism. My water pump broke while I was on the way to Miami, and they understood the urgency right away. They took care of my truck immediately and even waited more than 30 minutes after closing time so I could pick it up. Excellent service, very professional and honest. Highly recommended. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Barbara Zapatka
reviews.text: My visit Ideal Auto yesterday was wonderful. The staff was receptive and helpful, the work done was exactly what I needed and at a very reasonable price. I have never had an issue with Ideal Auto and I highly recommend This business for anyone looking for honest And hard-working mechanics. I am grateful to Zen and Sandra who own and operate the business. I have always been able to depend on them for their support, guidance and knowledge about my car. This is invaluable to me.

reviews.author: Craig Allen
reviews.text: Zen and his crew at Ideal Auto do good work at a great price, and quickly. My family has taken 3 different cars there and the results are always the same: they get it done quickly and conscientiously and at a better price than the bigger shops I'vebeen to. Just watch your head if you are tall when you go into the office!

reviews.author: Mikhail Pavliukov
reviews.text: I brought my 2013 Audi S4 to Ideal Auto for a transmission swap, and Zen and his team did an amazing job! From start to finish, they kept me updated and made the whole process smooth. The work was done very quickly, and the quality is top-notch. What really stood out to me was the unbeatable pricing, there’s no way anyone can match the value they provide. On top of that, the whole team was professional, knowledgeable, and easy to work with. I really appreciate the honesty, the care they put into the job, and the excellent experience overall. If you’re looking for quality work, fair pricing, and a team you can trust, I highly recommend Ideal Auto and Zen

reviews.author: Kwame Davis
reviews.text: Zen and his crew always come through in clutch. Took me in today and got my car back within 3 hours. Also warranty on parts as well! The only auto repair shop I’m working with from now on.

reviews.author: Debbie Ducharme EA
reviews.text: Sadly our truck was in an accident near Bosch in Anderson. Our insurance called this company to tow our vehicle to Caliber Collision in Anderson. We just received the bill for over $700 for the tow. This was for “special equipment “ (see photo) and for 22 miles. In addition, when it arrived all our belongings were missing. Though I do not know how our belongings became missing we do know our truck was dropped off at Caliber Collision without any notification to the business. Would not recommend this company for anything!!

reviews.author: Maria Allen
reviews.text: Quick, affordable service! Had my car in and out with all repairs done in less than a day from when I first called about availability. The business had excellent customer service and the owner even stayed after closing to make sure I had a ride home after I dropped off my car. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: olivia sculley
reviews.text: Ideal Auto Repair LLC was able to help me with a tow that was after hours, and he was super nice and accommodating for the late tow! He was right on time and worked really promptly and did the tow perfectly, I can't recommend them enough! It's hard to even find a towing service that will answer your call, and Ideal Auto Repair LLC went above and beyond, and I'm super thankful for helping me make a potentially stressful situation less stressful.

reviews.author: Vanessa Martin
reviews.text: VERY fair pricing and quick work! My car has been handling amazing since they fixed it. Both Zen and his wife are super nice. I’ve been recommending them to everyone!

reviews.author: andre aikens
reviews.text: This shop is top of the line .. he has been working on My 2013 Mercedes c250 and very was very reasonable .. Zen is the owner is firm but very fair his wife (Sandra) works in the office and she is a very sweet person... The mechanics are very knowledgeable .. I will continue to use the hidden gem auto repair business from this point on they have been great with upfront pricing and not taking advantage of you in any way .. I would recommend this one hundred times over .. contact Zen the owner he will take care of you. .. like I said he is firm but but one of the best mechanics and guy you will meet.. give them a call and I guarantee you won't regret it

reviews.author: Lindsey Bell
reviews.text: Great price and great people, we've been bringing our vehicles here for a few years now and we have no regrets, the folks here are wonderful and the repairs are always effective!

reviews.author: Author Sydney Landon
reviews.text: Zen and Sandy are the best. They are the only people we let work on our cars. They are affordable, honest, and very knowledgeable. We are so glad that we found them. They do amazing work on our Mercedes. We have also used their towing service as well. Best prices around.

reviews.author: Ian Harris
reviews.text: I was coming back from out of town and my check engine light came on, then my engine overheat started flashing. I had to get my car towed to my home. Furthermore, I immediately contacted one of those mobile repair companies. The company shows up and tells me I have a bad radiator and in order to get it repaired plus labor would be around $1500. I thanked them for the quote and told them I was going to get a second opinion. I contacted Ideal repair, and they had a tow truck to my home within 30 min of the call. And the owner told me it was just a bad hose that connected to the radiator. That was the only issue. They even replaced the clips that the first company broke when they were doing their diagnostic tests. From the phone call to my car being repaired the next day for under 400$ for my 2013 Cadillac cts is absolutely amazing. Ideal Auto showed that they are a company that can be trusted and that they are about quality work and efficiency. I will be taking all my cars to ideal going forward, and I will refer all my colleagues to Ideal Auto. Happy New Years, Guys.

reviews.author: Holly Kopp
reviews.text: Towed and repaired my vehicle within 24 hours and saves me a ton of money by correctly diagnosing the battery terminals as the problem versus what I was led to believe by another business.who said it was a bad alternator. That diagnosis saved me a ton of money. Thankful for their honesty I will use their services again for sure.

reviews.author: Justin Wagner
reviews.text: My old ford blew a wheel bearing when I was an hour from home, but thankfully I was only a few minutes from this shop. They got me back on the road in just a few days and did good work at a fair price. I highly recommend using this shop.

reviews.author: Sarah Kramer
reviews.text: We chose Ideal because it had good reviews online and was on my commute to work. Very quick service and had our first car repaired within one day! Prices are very reasonable. We took our second car there because it was overheating and the heat wasn't working. They replaced the water pump and the car overheated the very next day. Took it back and they said the fan also needed replaced and replaced it at cost. Said they had initially not checked the fan because they were looking for leaks and didn't check the fan. Heat still doesn't work, but will try another shop next time.

reviews.author: Lynn Strickland
reviews.text: Zen and Johnny are the best! Had two cracks in the transmission and they were able to fix it. They were quick and didn't charge me my first born. Reasonable on their charges. If you need anything done go by and see them or call them! Great folks there!

reviews.author: James Glenn
reviews.text: I would like to take this time to thank ideal auto for doing a fantastic job on my vehicle. It's a great pleasure of doing great business with ideal auto, and I would recommend them to my friends and family members, thanks for the great service, keep up the good work.

reviews.author: Jaxson Blinkhorn
reviews.text: The owner had amazing customer service and helped me a lot as I had just recovered my stolen vehicle and had it towed here. He went above and beyond to help me tow it to my house and backed it into a super difficult area that other tow yards had not ever been able to tow it to before. Highly recommend him for your towing and automotive needs. Thank you!

reviews.author: paula demeary
reviews.text: I bought a used car that began running hot within a week, twice in one month and the place I bought it from (Good Cars Auto Sales, also in Greenville) insisted they had fixed it each time I took it back. After the 3rd time, my son recommended Ideal Auto Repair and literally within 40 minutes after having it towed to them, Ideal had located the real problem and lo and behold they ACTUALLY fixed it. I was so relieved, and especially relieved that it made the 2 1/2 hrs trip to my home with NO PROBLEMS overheating. Much thanks to a nice and skilled staff!

reviews.author: Carlton Cruell
reviews.text: This was an excellent experience. They care about customer satisfaction and do excellent work. They repaired my company vehicle and it's running perfect. I would recommend to anyone. They also repaired my friend's A/C when others costs were quite tremendous and saved us a lot of money and time. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ted Finlay
reviews.text: While traveling through SC on I-85 my car suddenly lost power and would not go in to any gear. I had the car towed to Ideal thinking that the transmission was shot on my 2002 Ford Escape. The folks at Ideal said they would take a look at it and let me know. This was a Saturday at 11 AM and by 5 PM my car was fixed - a front axle had fallen apart - and the guys at Ideal had it fixed and on my way for a very, very fair price. Being from out of state, they could have told me anything. But they were very honest and I would recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Katrina B
reviews.text: After having a very bad experience waiting on the side of the road for an hour for another company , We called Ideal Auto Repair and Zen was there to pick us up in fifteen minutes. The other guy was also going to charge us double what Ideal Auto did. We are very pleased with the work ethic from this company and look forward to working with them on getting our car repaired.

reviews.author: thelonepo3t
reviews.text: A very shady business. I took my car to get my head gasket replaced. The car drove fine for 2 weeks then everything started breaking. I took the car to another mechanic and I was told Ideal Auto messed something up during the procedure. They swapped out my Brand New Distributor for my old one saying it was "Bad". The Distributor wasn't even 3 months old. I had a Brand new starter that I put in and he took it out and replaced it with another starter without my approval. Then told me it was bad and I needed to change it. The car broke down 2 weeks later. Everytime I took my car to this place it BROKE DOWN within 2 weeks after the work. Towing is great...Everything else this company offers is shady. Buyer Beware

reviews.author: Tashya Gray
reviews.text: On August 9 we had car trouble on I85 near a Greenville exit. We stopped at a convenience store to ask about a garage near by. We were sent to Ideal Auto Repair on Roe Road. A mechanic took care of the repair immediately and 10 minutes later we were back on the road. I can't say enough good things about the owner and the mechanic that took care of us. My only disappointment is that we don't live closer and have them take care of all of our car needs.

reviews.author: Quantavius Anderson
reviews.text: I bought a car from them and they fixed everything that was wrong with the car before they sold it to me. Zen is a honest person! They do really good work and know what they are doing. Zen is a man of his word! I totally trust them and would recommend them.

reviews.author: Lloyd Bolt
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! They hauled a Corvette for me from Belton to Powdersville yesterday. I was worried about hauling it because it sits so low. They had all the right equipment and handled it very gently. They were reasonably priced and very punctual. I could not have been more pleased. Thank you Zen and Johnny!

reviews.author: omar shabazz
reviews.text: They worked on my 2009 BMW and they were very quick and professional when they put my new starter in and they were fair with the price. Thank you.

reviews.author: AB Gentry
reviews.text: We brought our car in ro cooling fan not working. They had the car for 6 days. They said it was this, then that and then called and said we can't fix it. Owner said he changed the fuse, and it was blown and the problem is the ECU and it will cost you 2k. In back of my head I was saying it has to be the fuse, so we got it home opened the 60 watts fuse, and he tried to solder the fuse. I called the dealership where he said he got it and there is no record of any fuse bought with my vin number. I got my soldering kit out and fixed the job in 2 mins.. I ordered a new fuse just for back up. Very disappointed not for them not fixing it, but the inconsistency in their actions and words. I felt like it was crazy long time to misdiagnosis the plb and terrible diagnostic skills.

reviews.author: Randy
reviews.text: We were very pleased with the quality of service here. The issue we had involved considerable diagnosis and was a bit time consuming. When the problem was finally found, the owner was great at working with us to review available part quality and pricing that fit our budget. Thanks Ideal Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Paula
reviews.text: Horrible! When they "fixed" my car they just made it worse. When my car broke down just a few minutes after leaving.... I called back just to ask a question and was told they couldn't keep going back and forth with me. I had only been there twice and I PAID for the "fixing" that was done. How are you a mechanic but you don't got time to do what you do and get money for it??? Lol!! A joke to say the least.

reviews.author: Douglas Gambrell
reviews.text: Best prices I've ever seen towed me 17 miles and charged 100. Called them and they arrived 15 minutes later! Nice people, fast and affordable!!

reviews.author: Apryl Ramey
reviews.text: Awesome job! My car was repaired cheaper and faster than others quoted. Zen and Sandy are so friendly and put me at ease that a good job was being done. Thank y'all so much. My new mechanic!!

reviews.author: Randy Wilkinson
reviews.text: Traveling from out of town when we broke down. Called Ideal Auto Repair, John gave super fast response, towed, repaired and back on the road within a few hours. Courteous, kind, professional and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: tammy bakken
reviews.text: Zen who is the owner of ideal auto has been taking care of our cars for years. We call him and he always says bring it right in and has it done in a few days. We trust him and would only go to him.

reviews.author: Amy Cruz
reviews.text: Ideal Auto did an awesome job on my car. I’ve been taking my car to them for 2 years. I just had some work done and my car is running smooth again.

reviews.author: Sylvia Fox
reviews.text: I ended up getting stranded & these guys came to save us and they're getting my car fixed and their prices are really reasonable very respectful very pleasant I definitely will recommend this place to anybody I wish they were closer to me. thank you so much I feel like God bless me to meet you today.

reviews.author: Jonathan Lollis
reviews.text: Zen and Johnny are great. If you want an honest mechanic who isnt going to jerk you around, this is the place to go. My family and I have been using this shop for years and so should you.

reviews.author: Janice Etscovitz
reviews.text: Zen is WONDERFUL! He towed our car to Marietta, Ga from Greenville, South Carolina .Such a nice, nice person. Call Ideal Auto with all your auto repair or towing needs.

reviews.author: Michael Anderson
reviews.text: Great service and pricing. Quality honest work. Good to know their still earnest people out there! 10/10!!

reviews.author: Hope Derrick
reviews.text: Our daughters car was towed by them after an accident. Very rude to us when we got there initially and very rude to her when she had to go back the next day to get her things. Very unprofessional at a very hard time for our family

reviews.author: Constance S
reviews.text: The owner was very kind and helped me so much! I would recommend to anyone who wants genuinely good car service from genuinely good people.

reviews.author: Lewis Tarrence
reviews.text: I blew a tire at the red light next to their shop without my Jack and 4 way. They changed my tire free of charge. The owner is a real saint.

reviews.author: Derek Knecht
reviews.text: His prices were the best, he was extremely helpfully and worked with me despite me getting the wrong part and having to make him wait. I would absolutely recommend him to anyone and I will continue to use his services

reviews.author: Kimberly Van Pelt
reviews.text: Won't take my car anywhere else. They always take great care of me and my car. Rates are very reasonable too.

reviews.author: Darren P
reviews.text: Great rates on tow and repairs. They excel at working on european cars. Won't trust anyone else with my Volkswagen.

reviews.author: Ogeebo Reeves
reviews.text: These people are about business. The diagnose the problem and have your car back to you fixed and ready to go in no time

reviews.author: rick woodleaf
reviews.text: Zen and Johnny are the best I was having trouble with my car and asked my friend where to go to get it fixed He said to go to see Zen and I'm glad he did He fixed it RIGHT the first time and price was very reasonable Zen and Johnny are the BEST!!!!

reviews.author: Amanda Ridgell
reviews.text: They are so kind and trustworthy. Every-time I have gone I know they are doing what’s best for me and my car.

reviews.author: Atown Ryder
reviews.text: Friendly customer service reasonable pricing i will definitely be back when I need one of my vehicles worked on!

reviews.author: Brian Spanner
reviews.text: In the middle of a road trip and needed a place to replace our alternator on a Saturday. They opened up a spot for us and we were on our way in an hour!

reviews.author: Dollie Jones
reviews.text: Very professional, prompt, and courteous service. Johnny went the extra mile. Thank you again Ideal Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Brian Cawthon
reviews.text: Good service and friendly, experienced staff. They stand behind their work and have up to date technology to keep them moving foward. Highly recomended!

reviews.author: Chad Searcy
reviews.text: Great service. Was there in 20 mins to haul me and my truck in. My guy even left in the middle of lunch hour to get me. Thanks!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Head
reviews.text: This guy is a frightening driver. He just cut us off in a busy intersection. We were within inches of a terrible wreck.

reviews.author: Krystle Gilstrap
reviews.text: My daughters car broke down, zen was recommended to us by a family friend. He towed her car in was up front about possible issues and kept in contact, got her car back up and running within the week and gave a fair price. Outstanding customer service and communication. Highly recommend if your looking for a honest fair auto repair. Thank you so much!
